answer: Registration needs a cedar bond and a separate island attestation, but the quorum grows: the kth identity under one operator carries k attestations, each from a different island on a different river segment, and no island or river segment may attest twice for that operator. The operator funds one cedar per attestation, so n identities lock n(n+1)/2 cedar across n(n+1)/2 distinct island-segment pairs. A newcomer's first identity locks one cedar with one island; fakes cannot pool segment or reuse an attestor.
